## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ManageEnvironments`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `manage-environments`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ManageEnvironments**.

## Step 2: Create an environment

1. On the environments page, select **+ Create Environment**.
2. <!-- manual: Fill in the Create Environment form: -->
3. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Edit an environment

1. On the environments page, select **Edit** icon on an environment row.
2. <!-- manual: Update Name, Description, or the Mark as critical environment setting. The Handler is read-only after creation. -->
3. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Delete an environment

1. On the environments page, select **Delete** icon on an environment row.
2. <!-- manual: Type the environment name in the confirmation dialog to confirm. -->
3. Select **Delete**.
